Name: Abigail Male NSFD Version - Abner
Author: MarvelBrazilianBoy
Description:
Abigail Male (Genderbend)
This mod transforms our favorite mystic, Abigail, into her NSFD male version. Ideal for those who want to give the village a new look or are looking for a new male romance option with the same "alternative" personality we all love.

What this mod changes:
Portraits: New art for all dialogues and expressions.

Sprites: The character model in the map (overworld) has been completely redesigned for the male version.

Dialogues: Minor grammatical adjustments to reflect the gender change (optional, depending on your file version).

How to install:
Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.

Download this mod and extract the folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

Start the game and have fun!
